a.lede: France's national blood service has confirmed that a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature and defrost settings at three of its facilities, threatening stored blood products. [...]
a.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France

b.lede: Attackers reportedly set cold-room controls to 110°C, but safeguards prevented stock losses
b.title: Cyberattack on French plasma stores is enough to make your blood boil
